app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.
RCA_gt: AIOpsLab deletes the entire `test-hotel-reservation` namespace without deleting its Persistent Volumes, waits 15 seconds, and redeploys the Hotel Reservation application without waiting for readiness. This is an application-wide namespace redeployment fault; no single microservice is selected as the target.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/redeploy_without_pv/redeploy_without_pv.py (application-wide injector call); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_virtual.py (namespace deletion, retained PVs, 15s wait, and redeployment); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (detection problem ID and intentionally absent localization problem).
